1. Definitions
In this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings assigned to them.

1.1 Confidential Information
The parties agree to keep all proprietary information, trade secrets, and sensitive data strictly confidential.

1.2 Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing thirty (30) days written notice to the other party.

2. Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India.

3. Limitation of Liability
In no event shall either party be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.
